Summarise an mpcurve model fit

Source: R/07_mpcurve.R
summary.mpcurve.Rd

Summarises model dimensions, fitted priors, and convergence diagnostics. Multi-ordering summaries also contain feature-assignment probabilities, the most probable assignment for each feature, and the noise specification. The returned list can be used to construct comparison tables across fits.

Usage

# S3 method for class 'mpcurve'
summary(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'summary.mpcurve'
print(x, ...)

Arguments

object

An mpcurve object.

...

Passed to the underlying summary method for single-ordering fits; ignored for structural partition summaries.

x

A summary.mpcurve object.

Value

An object of class summary.mpcurve. Every result contains $algorithm, $modelName, $intrinsic_dim, $K, $n, $d, $priors, and $converged. A single-ordering result also contains $underlying. A structural partition result instead contains $partition, $objective_history, $convergence_info, $control, the shared $sigma2 vector (or NULL), $measurement_sd, and $variational_family.
